claims.content: To review the status of a provider claim, including determining if it is 'Accepted', 'Rejection', or 'Quarantine' based on data validity and mandatory information, and to capture the reason for rejection or quarantine.

goal.raw_text: To review the status of a provider claim, including determining if it is 'Accepted', 'Rejection', or 'Quarantine' based on data validity and mandatory information, and to capture the reason for rejection or quarantine.

claims.content: VMU User
Claim has been submitted with complete mandatory information
Thumb impression has been captured from the patient and stuck on the claim form by VSP staff
User is authorized to alter/amend the Claim if required
Claim exists in the system database for review
The system detects that the claim status is not 'Accepted' due to false or missing mandatory information, or identifies a thumb impression mismatch for the same patient on the same voucher.

trigger.raw_text: The system detects that the claim status is not 'Accepted' due to false or missing mandatory information, or identifies a thumb impression mismatch for the same patient on the same voucher.

claims.content: VMU User accesses the claim record in the system to review its status.
System displays the current Claim Status, which depends on information available in the Claim — if any false data or mandatory information is missing, status changes from 'Accepted'.
If status is not 'Accepted', system stores the claim in quarantine area and allows progression based on status.
System provides provision for VMU User to capture the reason if claim status is 'Rejection' or 'Quarantine'.
System captures thumb impression from each claim form and compares it with same voucher numbers from previous visits if available.
If thumb impression mismatches for same patient (Client/Partner) on same voucher, system automatically makes a count on it.
If claim from same VSP has more than two times of Thumb Impression mismatching, system automatically produces a warning message and In-Activates the VSP.
Authorized VMU User can alter/amend the Claim if required.
If claim status is not 'Accepted', the claim is stored in quarantine area and can proceed further from its status.
System must capture reason if claim status is 'Rejection or Quarantine'.
If thumb impression mismatches for same patient (Client / Partner) on same voucher, system automatically makes a count on it.
If claim from same VSP has more than two times of Thumb Impression mismatching, system produces warning message and In-Activates the VSP.
Claim status is set to 'Accepted', 'Rejection', or 'Quarantine' based on data validity and mandatory information availability.
If claim status is 'Rejection' or 'Quarantine', the reason for that status has been captured in the system.
If thumb impression mismatch occurred for same patient (Client / Partner) on same voucher, a count was automatically recorded by the system.
If more than two thumb impression mismatches were detected from same VSP, the system produced a warning message and In-Activated the VSP.
Authorized user may have altered or amended the Claim if required during review.
